basis: Lab Phase 3 GATE A (docs/lab/phase-3/gate-a-proposal.md §4); supersedes 1.0.0 once the CSO signs it. Until then 1.0.0 is in force and no cadre holds lab.stock.manage or poct.assess.
notes: Cadre codes are the AHPC lab cadres seeded in 0009. A cadre not listed here holds no lab permission.
lab.manage is never granted by cadre: it comes only from an open department_heads row for the LABORATORY department (whole lab) or one of its sections (that section).

lab.qc.override, lab.eqa.manage and lab.hmis.check are never granted by cadre: they come with lab.manage, from an open department_heads row (substantive or acting) for LABORATORY or one of its sections.
